entries.description: FastAPI Dockerfile aligned with a PostgreSQL-backed service. Base image: python:3.11-slim. Installs pip requirements, sets ENV PORT=8000, exposes 8000. CMD uses ${PORT:-8000} for configurable port binding at runtime.
decision_rules: Use when framework=fastapi, project_type=api_backend, dependencies include postgres
Use PORT env variable to allow dynamic port assignment in orchestration environments
tradeoffs: No multi-stage build — simpler but larger final image than a distroless multi-stage variant
No non-root user — extend with USER directive before CMD for production security
anti_patterns: Do not embed DATABASE_URL or credentials in the Dockerfile
Do not expose the database port inside the application container Dockerfile
